You manage to sleep through the night.
But you dream of nothing.
scene norikowakeup1
I walk outside to be met with a rather mysterious temperature given how the air felt in this exact place less than twelve hours ago.
It’s actually warm out this morning.
And while I don’t know if this is just some strange coincidence or a sign from a god I don’t believe in, I accept it.
Also, if this is a sign, whoever that god may be is making a pretty good argument for itself right now.
I applaud him or her or it for waiting for such a good opportunity to grant us warmth, for I now have a significantly higher likelihood of seeing girls in less clothing for the duration of the day.
But then the wind blows and sprays my blazer with a thin layer of mist and I go back to hating any and all gods that may or may not exist or whatever.
Oh, and then Noriko shows up.
scene norikowakeup2
: Hey! Good morning!
: Did you sleep well?
if dormwarfloor2win == True:
: Kind of, I guess.
: I was a little surprised to not see you there when I woke up, though.
scene norikowakeup3
: Yeaaaaaah...as it turns out, I may have cuddled you a little too hard and some of the girls thought it was kind of weird and asked me to stop.
scene norikowakeup4
: But, on the bright side, I didn’t drug you this time! You were totally knocked out by your own doing and I, in no way, had anything to do with you sleeping in so late and so heavily.
: Saying it like that does make you seem a little suspicious, though.
: I tend to say a lot of stuff that makes me seem more suspicious than I actually am. It’s kind of my thing.
: So, what then? You all just decided to let me stay in there by myself instead of swarming me?
scene norikowakeup2
: Pretty much, yeah.
: Touka got up first to go for her morning walk or something and then came back in telling us all how nice it was outside.
: The rest is pretty much history, I guess.
: Io kicked you a few times to see if you’d wake up, but you were like out of it out of it, if you know what I mean.
: I’m pretty sure you mean I was out of it.
: Yup! That!
else:
: Kind of, I guess.
: Ami and Ayane had a little trouble sharing me and I’m pretty sure Chika wound up staying awake the entire night to make sure neither of them went too far.
scene norikowakeup5
: Really? That’s super cool of her.
: I’m sure she had her own reasons that I would be very upset to hear, but I’ll still probably thank her anyway.
: I realized again last night just how much Ayane likes you, so it makes me a little happy knowing nothing really intense went on during the sleepover thingy.
: You were with Ayane last night?
: Yeah. We talked about masturbating and stuff.
: I can very much see how that would lead to you reaffirming her feelings about me.
: You’re not worried about Ami, though?
: Not really. Ami’s part of the family and will never marry you or have your babies or anything, so if you two want to secretly go at it without anybody knowing, I guess that’s fine.
: Luckily for you, I can’t see that happening anytime soon.
: Or...ever, for that matter.
: That is lucky for me! But very unfortunate for Ami.
: Here’s hoping she doesn’t wind up resorting to the same thing I did when I was little and the person I liked was already interested in somebody else.
: What did you do when you were little, exactly?
: Not telling. But something tells me you probably would have found out if my floor won the dorm war.
scene norikowakeup7
: Wait, why are we even talking about this? Tell me about the rest of the night.
: I thought about coming to visit, but Makoto caught me as I opened the door and said a whole bunch of stuff about “accepting defeat” and then kicked me out.
: It was...fine. A little anticlimactic, but fine.
scene norikowakeup6
: I see...
: Well...maybe we’ll get to do this again some day and you’ll wind up staying with us next time?
: I wonder if...by then, we’ll be...
: Be what? Finish your sentence.
scene norikowakeup4
: Nah. I’ll just show you what I mean soon instead.
: Right...
: So, that aside, what’s the plan for today?
scene norikowakeup8
: Plan? Are we supposed to have one of those?
: I think we were just gonna do whatever.
: I know a lot of the girls are back over where they keep the picnic tables and stuff, so I was gonna head over there soon if you wanted to come.
: I’m sure basically all of them would be happy to see you.
: Sure, that sounds-
scene norikowakeup9
: Hm? That sounds what? Why did you stop?
: There’s, uhh...an idol behind you.
: An...idol?
scene norikowakeup10
: Ah! Nee-chan! I didn’t know you were here!
: Are you fucking kidding me? Yes you did.
: How many beaches do you think there are in Kumon-mi?
: More than one? I don’t know. I’ve never counted them before.
: What’s going on here?
scene norikowakeup11
: That’s what I should be asking you, dick!
: This is why you couldn’t see me this weekend? Because you were going on a romantic getaway with my little sister?
: You realize how old-
: Yup! Sensei knows so there’s no reason to continue that sentence.
scene norikowakeup12
: You are playing a dangerous game, Noriko. Remember who’s paying for your phone.
: Oh, come on. You hogged him for the first like...six million years of our lives. It’s my turn to get some time with him now that I’m not in training bras anymore.
: If it’s any consolation, Niki, I am also paying for the phone bill of several [high_school]ers.
scene norikowakeup13
: How is that consolation?! That’s fucking weird!
Niki takes off her fancy sunglasses and tosses them into a bag positioned off screen. I promise it is there.
: Also, no one has told me why you two are together yet!
: You guessed it correctly the first time, Nee-chan. Sensei and I are on a romantic getaway and were moments away from christening every room in this here inn.
scene norikowakeup14
: There better be a good fucking explanation for this or neither of you two are leaving here alive.
: It’s just some[school] trip thing. Don’t kill me.
: A better question is why you are here. Don’t you have like...idol stuff to do or whatever?
scene norikowakeup15
: Why yes, I do. Thank you for asking and acknowledging my...awesomeness.
: I’m actually here because of “idol stuff.”
: I have a photoshoot for a swimsuit calendar this afternoon and the agency managed to snatch up a room at this inn from some rich family who bought the rest of them.
: I see. And where will I be able to purchase this calendar?
scene norikowakeup16
: Heh. I’ll see if I can use one of my many, many connections to get you one once it’s printed.
: Um, hello? Cute girl literally in a swimsuit right next to you two in search of praise. Send help.
scene norikowakeup17
: Not much I can do until you grow a little bit more, Noriko. Don’t blame me for being significantly more attractive and adored by all.
: I know where you sleep, bitch.
: So, since you’re going to be doing a photoshoot or whatever, does this mean you won’t have any free time?
scene norikowakeup18
: The only free time I have is literally right now. I’m on a tight schedule- which is exactly why I tried to tell you about this ahead of time.
: But no. You already made plans with my sister because you subconsciously want to be reminded of me without having to admit that you were wrong for abandoning me years ago.
: Or...and hear me out here...maybe his tastes just haven’t changed since he was a [teenager].
: They sure fucking better have.
: Can you at least come say hi to a few of the girls? I know at least two of them would be really excited to see someone as...awesome and amazing as you.
I obviously don’t remember much about Niki (Assuming any of my background is true) but, the one thing I absolutely do know is that her ego is very easily stroked.
And, just like with the whole thing about paying for[teen]phone bills, I can relate.
scene norikowakeup19
: Well, duh. I’m Niki Nakayama. It would be weirder if there weren’t girls excited to see me.
: But even though I have a little free time, it’s not like I can just go wherever you want to take me and-
: Ami should be there, Nee-chan.
scene norikowakeup20
: She’s a big fan, too. She’s been listening to you this whole time.
scene norikowakeup21
: Mnh...
: Is that really all it takes to sway her?
: Nee-chan spent years worrying about you and Ami after what happened.
: Even though you couldn't have cared any fucking less about what I was or wasn’t worrying about.
: Besides, it’s not like she’ll remember me as me when I only met her once or twice. She’ll just see me as...Niki.
: But...you are Niki.
scene norikowakeup22
: You know that’s not what I mean.
: Sure, she’ll probably ask you for an autograph and...cry or something. But if you really were worried about her, wouldn’t you want to at least see who she is or...what she looks like now?
scene norikowakeup23
: I’m with Sensei on this one.
: In fact, I’m enforcing the Nakayama Sisters’ Rule #74 at this very moment. You are unable to refuse.
: Rule #74 at a time like this? But...what would I even say?
: “Hi, Ami. I’m a famous idol you listen to on the radio, but I’m also your [uncle]’s ex and have been worried about you for years. Want to take a selfie together?”
: Can I just quickly touch on the fact that you two have an absurd amount of rules? What does rule #74 even do?
scene norikowakeup24
: Nakayama Sisters’ Rule #74: If a Nakayama sister believes the other is making a decision they will regret, they can enact this rule to strip them of free will and force one to act for the other.
: Okay, first off- you two are creepy.
: Secondly, how old were you when you came up with that? I thought this was going to be a kid thing at first, but that was a very professionally worded rule.
scene norikowakeup25
: It’s more like a law, I guess. But it wouldn’t exist if there wasn't a reason for it, so...
: If Noriko is going to enact Rule #74 now, I don’t really have a choice other than to go along with it.
: Having a sister sounds exhausting.
: It is.
scene norikowakeup26
: Pfft...
scene black
The Nakayama sisters erupt into a fit of laughter as I am left to stand beside them, wondering how far back this goes and whether or not it’s something I ever found out about.
Perhaps in a previous life-
Perhaps then, I would have understood more about their silly rules.
About what their relationship is with not only each other, but with me and the girl Niki was apparently so worried about for years.
It must have been hard having to live with those thoughts.
I wonder why, if that person from back then was actually me-
I wonder why they locked her out.
She seems kind enough.
Sure, she’s a stuck up princess but, if what I understand about her is correct, isn’t she only like that because of me?
If so, why did I leave her behind?
Everything I learn about those two makes the past seem brighter-
But perhaps the issue is that it’s becoming so bright that it’s too blinding to see anything else.
And perhaps the reason Maya is so hesitant to me finding out any more about it is because its inescapable light will consume the world I’m in now.
Maya is in that world, so I don’t blame her for not wanting to be consumed.
But I also shouldn’t be blamed for occasionally quelling the misery of others when it requires minimal effort on my end in order to do so.
All I’m doing is walking down the beach with two cute girls who love me.
Well, one cute girl who loves me and one other cute girl who hates me.
But also loves me.
Probably.
And if the three of us happen to bump into one more girl who loves me-
One more girl who goes back just as long as the two of them, if not longer-
If that happens, it will just be a coincidence.
It will not be my fault.
Nothing is ever my fault.
scene norikowakeup27
: Onward! To [niece]hood!
: Are you really just going to let her pull you along like that?
: I...guess so?
scene norikowakeup28
: Hah...you’ve always been too nice to her. You just let her do whatever she wants.
: No wonder she’s this obsessed with you now instead of chasing after someone actually worth the time and effort.
: Sorry, but aren’t you the same Niki Nakayama who tried to invite me on a work trip because she couldn’t get enough of me?
scene norikowakeup29
: Of course not.
: I’m the Niki Nakayama who tried to invite you on a work trip because I didn’t want to carry my own luggage.
: But it’s fine now. I just got one of the people from the agency to do it instead. I don’t need you anymore.
: Then I guess I’ll just go back to enjoying my romantic getaway with your little sister and-
scene norikowakeup30
: Yeah, yeah. Do whatever you want. I know you’ll come crawling back soon enough.
: Just keep on walking, [nikitemp]. You have a grand total of roughly ten minutes with me and you shouldn’t be wasting them on your textbook sarcasm.
scene black
I begrudgingly do as I’m told and shut my mouth, though I’m not sure why.
We continue walking along the shoreline together until the entrance of the beach and its accompanying picnic tables come into view.
And in the hundreds of seconds it takes to get there, not one feels out of place.
